scripts.build: bun run build:truck && bun run check:sizes && bun run build:truck-web && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:sync: cd systems/sync/crate && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../../truck/web/pkg-sync && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir ../../truck/worker/pkg-sync
scripts.build:truck: bun run build:sync && cd systems/truck/crate && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../web/pkg-browser-renderer && cargo run --bin generate-schema 2>/dev/null > ../cad-schema.json
scripts.build:truck-web: bun run gen:api-types && cd systems/truck/web && bun run build
scripts.build:docs: bun scripts/build-llm-docs.ts && cd systems/docs/website && bun install --silent && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd systems/truck/worker && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: node check-alignment.mjs && bun run typecheck && bun run test:crate && bun run test:api
scripts.test:crate: cargo test -p truck-sync && cargo test -p truck-webgpu-gui --no-default-features --features native
scripts.test:api: cd systems/truck/worker && bun x vitest run
scripts.test:api:watch: cd systems/truck/worker && bun x vitest watch
scripts.test:e2e: cd systems/truck/tests && bun x playwright test
